cases.no_tag_rescan: Six-stage no-card scan completes; M2 starts one new scan and returns to no-tag.
cases.collision_refuses_reader: A synthetic collision result displays the warning and never starts a Reader.
cases.single_tag_reader_dispatch: Real scan/parser/translation dispatch exactly one Reader with the accepted UID and type.
cases.cancel_inflight_empty: PWR during a held no-tag response exits and ignores the late worker callback.
cases.cancel_inflight_found: PWR during the Gen1 probe after UID parsing exits without starting a Reader from the late found result.
cases.exit_reenter: After exit and worker completion, a fresh activity can scan again without stale callbacks.
cases.console_roundtrip: Console opens during reader dispatch; PWR restores the read screen, then exits cleanly.
cases.decoder_absent: Real discovery with empty serial inventory reports absent decoder and permits exit.
cases.reader_success: Real scan, Reader, LF protocol/parser and dump saving reach read success with the expected identity.
cases.reader_queued_exit: A real Reader finishes without waiting for Tk; PWR before UI delivery discards its queued completion.
cases.reader_cancel_reenter: PWR during a real Reader's held response exits without a stale result; after worker completion, re-entry reads successfully.
cases.reader_failure_retry: A completed LF command with no tag data cannot report success or save a dump; rescan and a new Reader recover.
cases.reader_cancel_overlap: PWR returns while a Reader response remains held; immediate re-entry keeps Tk responsive and waits for old ownership, then scans/reads on fresh sockets without a cancelled dump.
